source.verse_hash_method: SHA-256 of the exact original XML verse substring, including written/read notes, not a normalized substitute.
source.public_versification_note: Public Numbers 19–24 aligns directly with Hebrew Numbers 19–24. All 182 original records, including every annotation, are hashed exactly. Later numbering differences require separate mapping.

key_decisions.decision: Keeps first month without supplying an unstated year; preserves both death and burial of Miriam.
Keeps take-staff versus speak-to-rock distinction, visible action and provision for animals; staff identity remains unasserted.
Makes singular speaker Moses clear, retaining we and the rebels accusation without inserting a motive.
Keeps two blows and abundant water despite the leaders’ failure; no invented failure of the miracle.
Preserves both men’s responsibility and stated trust/holiness reason without reducing it to only striking twice.
Retains dispute/holiness connection; note leaves among-them versus through-waters grammatical reference open.
Keeps angel/messenger agency as stated without identifying the figure; preserves border location.
Keeps gathered-to-people idiom and plural culpability; does not turn the idiom into a physical burial claim.
Preserves clothing transfer and both gathering/death clauses without embellishing ceremony.
